story.title: The Little Queen and the Ancient Gate

queen.name: Bright Little Queen
queen.ref_text: The moonlit tide is changing, and I can hear silver bells beneath the waves. Somewhere beyond that glowing gate, our lost kingdom is waiting. Come on, stay close—we've come much too far to turn back now.

demon.name: Ancient Demon
demon.ref_text: So, you are the little queen who opened the forgotten gate. Interesting. I expected someone taller. Still, courage has never cared much about size. Come closer and tell me why you have entered a place even kings were wise enough to avoid.

narrator.name: Story Narrator
narrator.ref_text: The moonlit tide is changing, and I can hear silver bells beneath the waves. Somewhere beyond that glowing gate, our lost kingdom is waiting. Come on, stay close—we've come much too far to turn back now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.direction: Calm opening narration with a slight sense of wonder and mystery.
lines.text: Once, beneath a mountain that no map dared to name, a forgotten gate waited for someone brave enough to open it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.direction: Slightly more intimate, drawing the listener closer.
lines.text: The key had been hidden for three hundred years. Tonight, a little queen held it in her hand.

lines.speaker: queen
lines.direction: Curious and a little nervous, but determined. Soft volume, genuine wonder.
lines.text: The key is warm. Why is the key warm?

lines.speaker: queen
lines.direction: Quiet resolve. She is speaking more to herself than to anyone else.
lines.text: If something has been waiting this long, then it must be important. I am not turning back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.direction: Building tension. The gate is about to open.
lines.text: She pressed the key into the ancient lock. Stone ground against stone. Cold air rushed out of the dark.

lines.speaker: demon
lines.direction: Slow, deep, amused. Completely in control.
lines.text: Hmph... so, little queen, you finally opened my gate.

lines.speaker: demon
lines.direction: Dark amusement mixed with genuine curiosity. Still calm and heavy.
lines.text: I have watched kingdoms rise, rot, and disappear while I waited beneath this mountain. Come closer. I want to see what sort of creature was foolish enough to wake me.

lines.speaker: queen
lines.direction: Brave, slightly defiant, still keeping her bright youthful character. Clear and steady.
lines.text: I didn't come to wake you. I came because something under this mountain is calling for help.

lines.speaker: demon
lines.direction: Genuine surprise held under centuries of arrogance.
lines.text: Help? How interesting. In all the centuries I have slept, no one has ever claimed they came to help me.

lines.speaker: queen
lines.direction: Earnest and a little fierce. Her courage is real even if she is small.
lines.text: Then maybe you have been waiting for the wrong kind of visitor. I am not here to take anything from you. I am here to listen.

lines.speaker: demon
lines.direction: Quiet, heavy consideration. The amusement softens into something older and more serious.
lines.text: Listen... Very well, little queen. Step into the light where I can see your face. If you are telling the truth, the mountain itself will know.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.direction: Soft closing of the scene. A sense that something important has begun.
lines.text: And so the little queen walked forward, into the dark that had waited for her, and the ancient gate closed behind them both.
